{{nihongo|'''Asamiya Shrine'''|朝宮神社 (春日井市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

'''Asamiya Shrine''' (Asamiya Jinja) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Asamiya-chō, Kasugai|Q18700422|qid=Q18700422|lt=Asamiya-chō}}, {{ill|Kasugai, Aichi|Q26101|qid=Q26101}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|Q80434|qid=Q80434}}.

=== Overview ===
It is identified with '''Waniyoshi Shrine''' of {{ill|Yamada district, Owari|Q11470699|qid=Q11470699|lt=Yamada District}}, {{ill|Owari Province|Q514506|qid=Q514506}}, as listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}; however, there are multiple shrines considered descendant shrines of Waniyoshi Shrine, including {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Waniyoshi Shrine}} enshrined in {{ill|Jōjō-chō|Q11359359|qid=Q11359359|lt=Kamijō-chō}}, Kasugai City, and the identification is not definitive.

According to shrine tradition, Waniyoshi Shrine, which had been enshrined in Asamiya-chō, was rebuilt in {{ill|Kempo (era)|Q1194251|qid=Q1194251}} 6 ({{ill|1218|Q5381|qid=Q5381}}) by {{ill|Kosaka Mitsuyoshi|Q11459397|qid=Q11459397}}, lord of {{ill|Jōjō Castle|Q532489|qid=Q532489|lt=Kamijō Castle}}, at {{ill|Jōjō-chō|Q11359359|qid=Q11359359|lt=Kamijō-chō}} under the new name Waniyoshi Hakusan Shrine. At the former site in Asamiya-chō, {{ill|Kikurihime|Q11619891|qid=Q11619891|lt=Kikurihime-no-Mikoto}} was invited and enshrined from {{ill|Shirayama Hime Shrine|Q704702|qid=Q704702}}, located in {{ill|Hakusan, Ishikawa|Q696407|qid=Q696407}}, {{ill|Ishikawa Prefecture|Q131281|qid=Q131281}}, and the shrine came to be called '''Asamiya Hakusan-gū'''. During the {{ill|Sengoku period|Q204023|qid=Q204023|lt=Sengoku period}}, the shrine buildings were destroyed by warfare, but they were rebuilt in the {{ill|Edo period|ar|فترة إيدو|ast|Periodu Edo|az|Edo dövrü|bcl|Panahon nin Edo|be|Перыяд Эда|bg|Едо (период)|bn|এদো যুগ|bo|ཨེ་དོའི་དུས་སྐབས།|br|Marevezh Edo|ca|Període Edo|ckb|سەردەمی ئێدۆ|cs|Období Edo|cv|Эдо тапхăрĕ|da|Edo-perioden|de|Edo-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Edo|es|Período Edo|et|Edo ajastu|eu|Edo aroa|fa|دوره ادو|fi|Edo-kausi|fr|Époque d'Edo|gl|Período Edo|he|תקופת אדו|hi|एदो अवधी|hr|Edo (razdoblje)|hu|Edo-kor|id|Zaman Edo|is|Jedótímabilið|it|Periodo Edo|ja|江戸時代|jv|Jaman Édo|ko|에도 시대|lt|Edo laikotarpis|lv|Edo periods|mk|Едо (период)|mn|Эдогийн эрин|ms|Zaman Edo|nl|Edoperiode|nn|Edotida|oc|Periòde Edo|pl|Edo (okres)|pt|Período Edo|ro|Perioada Edo|ru|Период Эдо|simple|Edo period|sk|Obdobie Edo|sl|Obdobje Edo|sq|Periudha Edo|sr|Едо период|su|Période Edo|sv|Edoperioden|th|ยุคเอโดะ|tl|Panahong Edo|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Eto|tr|Edo Dönemi|uk|Період Едо|ur|ایڈو دور|uz|Edo davri|vi|Thời kỳ Edo|war|Panahon Edo|wuu|江戶時代|zh|江户时代|zh_min_nan|Edo sî-tāi|zh_yue|江戶時代|qid=Q184963}}. A monument to {{ill|Asamiya Palace|Q11517371|qid=Q11517371}} stands adjacent to the shrine.
